title: Intel Community News | Parsons Launches iNET Convergent Response
summary: Parsons launched iNET Convergent Response, which combines its Intelligent Networks (iNET) platform with Team Awareness Kit (TAK) to help agencies share information in real time and coordinate responses during planned events, emergencies and security incidents. The post Intel Community News | Parsons Launches iNET Convergent Response appeared first on Parsons Corporation .
